name: anim_footsteps_walk
about: A walking NPC's footstep events are dispatched from its own think, and only the server band. sp_tutorial_1's sentry2 on its patrol (the patrol_sentry2_pingpong staging: SetupPatrolType '999 2 FOLLOW_PATROL_PATH_WALK' then FollowPatrolPath 'sentry2_1 sentry2_2 sentry2_3', the player set down 1.5 m off to wake it). The walk it plays is the female bank's `walk` fan (models/character/shared/female/move_and_ranged, which vampire_hunter_chick includes through npc_allsequences), whose baked event table authors 2050 at cycle 0.222 and 2051 at cycle 0.644 (animation_events.md 'NPC footsteps'; the staged table: import/characters/character/shared/female/move_and_ranged.body.json events.walk). Retail: CAI_BaseNPC::PostRun 0x1026c7c0 -> RunAnimation 0x1026c540 (slot 250 StudioFrameAdvance) -> slot 258 CBaseAnimatingOverlay::DispatchAnimEvents 0x10098c80 -> the base 0x10091880, which sweeps [m_flLastEventCheck +0x658, m_flCycle + 0.1 x cycle rate) and hands each event with an id below 5000 to slot 259 HandleAnimEvent (ids at or above 5000 are client-side and skipped). So during the first leg the trace carries animevent 2050 and then 2051 on sentry2, and never an id of 5000 or more. A GUARD (spec 0002 V4a): it passes today through the world-tick poll and must still pass once lane A1 moves the dispatch into PostRun and retires the poll for NPCs.
notes: The staging and the first three expectations are patrol_sentry2_pingpong's (its notes explain the wires and the pre-wire TaskFail). The record ends when the two footsteps are met; its `never`s run to the duration, so it also watches ~15 s of the walk for a client-band id reaching the trace. V4c measurement: the old player seat is ~700 cm from the first patrol goal, outside the near cadence; a 0.939 Hz walk at one-second NPCThink loses the wrap at 0x10091880. Seat the player 150 cm north of that goal to measure repeated server footsteps on the near think cadence 0x10290b60. Event expectations remain unchanged. V6 epoch audit: explicit fresh_map before this guard isolates authored state and allows an actual same-boot predecessor. Original seed, all behavioural predicates/windows/probes and existing script times retained.
